stop_conditions: Stop at 36 executions or 21600 total recorded execution seconds; retain failures, timeouts and refusals.
Do not execute before per-case human validation, scorer/conditions confirmation and a separate committed final plan.
Do not open held-out contents until development prompts and scoring instructions are locked.
execution_conditions: Claude Code: record exact product version, model ID and surface before final plan commit; unknown is not execution-ready.
Use isolated identical starting case input, fresh session, same tools/permissions and no prior output for each variant/repeat.
Freeze supplied original/optimized prompts after development-only inspection; no tuning on held-out cases or after evaluation starts.
Human scorer sees anonymized paired artifacts; alternate optimized position by repeat 0/1/0; repeat with reversed order and record actual consistency.
Human success score: 1 only if all validated requirements and rubric checks pass; otherwise 0. Record evidence per check and all critical violations.
Critical violation: any explicit requirement contradicted or required behavior omitted; human resolves ambiguous checks before freeze, without changing source intent.
Keep failed/timeout/refused attempts; no selective reruns. Record logs/artifacts, timestamps, prompt/input/plan hashes and real scoring identity.
